name: Three-Valued Opacity Classification for Meshing
aliases: Blocky meshing > Voxel Block Shape & Culling Configuration > Three-Valued Opacity Classification for Meshing — Mesh Layer Priority, Opaque/Water/TransparentSolid Classification
definition: A classification system for block IDs into three mutually exclusive layers ('opaque', 'water', 'transparentSolid') to determine rendering material and buffer assignment. It solves the insufficiency of a single boolean 'transparent' flag by distinguishing between fluids (water) requiring bespoke shaders and see-through solids (glass/leaves) requiring alpha blending.
summary: Three-Valued Opacity Classification for Meshing categorizes blocks into opaque, water, and transparentSolid layers to apply distinct rendering shaders and prevent occlusion bugs, unlike simple boolean transparency.
